gold_sql:
WITH p1 AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.878898 40.880372)',4326)) AS elev
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.878898 40.880372)',4326))
  LIMIT 1
),
p2 AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-79.958626 40.443874)',4326)) AS elev
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-79.958626 40.443874)',4326))
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  ABS(p1.elev - p2.elev) AS elevation_difference_m,
  p1.elev AS poi1_elevation_m,
  p2.elev AS poi2_elevation_m
FROM p1, p2;

WITH
  -- Extract the two points from the structured context
  points AS (
    SELECT 
      ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-73.878898, 40.880372), 4326)::geography AS geom_hospital,
      ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-79.958626, 40.443874), 4326)::geography AS geom_university
  ),
  -- Get elevation at each point using ST_Value
  elevations AS (
    SELECT
      ST_Value(r.rast, ST_Transform(p.geom_hospital::geometry, 4326)) AS elev_hospital,
      ST_Value(r.rast, ST_Transform(p.geom_university::geometry, 4326)) AS elev_university
    FROM
      points p,
      public.dem_us r
    WHERE
      ST_Intersects(r.rast, ST_Transform(p.geom_hospital::geometry, 4326))
      OR ST_Intersects(r.rast, ST_Transform(p.geom_university::geometry, 4326))
  )
-- Calculate the vertical separation in meters
SELECT 
  (elev_hospital - elev_university) AS vertical_separation_meters
FROM
  elevations
WHERE
  elev_hospital IS NOT NULL AND elev_university IS NOT NULL;
